displayName: Obfuscated Files or Information: Dynamic API Resolution

tests.name: Dynamic API Resolution-Ninja-syscall
tests.description: This test calls NtCreateFile via API hashing and dynamic syscall resolution. I have dubbed this particular combination of techniques 'Ninja-syscall'. When successful, a new file named 'hello.log' will be created in the default user's temporary folder, which is a common location for a dropper.
